name: Punnamada Day Cruiser
description: Follow the lake edge and the Kuttanad canals, with lunch aboard and return to the same jetty.

name: Kuttanad Palm Cabin
description: A private cabin for two, a shaded deck and dinner after the crew has moored the boat.

name: Vembanad Veranda
description: Leave from Kumarakom for a mix of open lake and narrower canals, with two cabins for a small group.

name: Paddy Fields Passage
description: Three cabins, a simple upper sitting area and a route through the Kuttanad paddy belt.

name: Lake at Dusk
description: An enclosed dining lounge and open deck with room to watch dusk settle over Vembanad.

name: Kumarakom Family Kettuvallam
description: Four cabins for a larger family, a shared dining deck and meal options arranged with the crew.
